episodes.synopsis: The bright and positive Sonny Wright along with his passionate teammates make the difficult decision of leaving their island home to continue their one joy in life; soccer.
episodes.title: Setting Sail to Tomorrow

episodes.synopsis: Sonny and the new Raimon Eleven struggle to understand the training given to them by their odd manager, Mister Yi.
episodes.title: The Devil of the Field

episodes.synopsis: The odd methods continue as Mister Yi gears the Raimon team up for their first official match against the school with an incredible defense, Rampart Jr. High.
episodes.title: The Mysterious Coach Zhao Jinyun

episodes.synopsis: The day is finally here. It's Raimon vs Rampart and Mister Yi is still up to his strange tactics.
episodes.title: Will It Fall?! The Impregnable Fortress

episodes.synopsis: Though an incredible striker, Elliot Ember fails to command his teammates' respect due to his inconsistent attendance and performance.
episodes.title: The Darkness of Seisho Academy

episodes.synopsis: Things heat up as Polestar Academy goes against Kirkwood Junior High. Renowned Flame Striker, Axel Blaze, leads Kirkwood players with great teamwork and powerful moves.
episodes.title: The Flame Ace Striker

episodes.synopsis: With Elliot's evolution into a dependable ace striker, Polestar Academy finally finds its footing against Kirkwood.
episodes.title: The Light That Comes into Sight

episodes.synopsis: The Raimon Eleven are left on their own against the analytical team, Anima Sana, in the 3rd round prelim.
episodes.title: A Day Without the Coach

episodes.synopsis: The diabolical Ray Dark is once again the commander of the Royal Academy team, despite being previously condemned.
episodes.title: Commander Kageyama Reiji's Clever Scheme

episodes.synopsis: The morale of Royal Academy starts to fall apart when the players find out Ray Dark's dishonest approach.
episodes.title: Clash! Emperor Penguin VS Polar Bear!!

episodes.synopsis: Sonny feels lost about his motive for playing soccer. Then, he receives a letter from his late mother with a message that may change everything.
episodes.title: The Night Before the Battle, Asuto's Decision

episodes.synopsis: In the final match of the preliminaries, it's once again Raimon vs Polestar.
episodes.title: Burning Haizaki

episodes.synopsis: Determined to crush Raimon, Elliot's onslaught is relentless. However, even with Sonny's injured leg, the eleven stand firm.
episodes.title: Fierce! The Final Stage of the Storm!!

episodes.synopsis: The Football Frontier finals begin and the story of the mysterious Heath Moore is about to unfold.
episodes.title: The Moonlight Emperor

episodes.synopsis: Elliot's chance for revenge is here as Polestar faces off against Lunar Prime.
episodes.title: The Emperor's Anguish

episodes.synopsis: Raimon may be facing their toughest opponents yet - Alpine Jr. High. Alpine Jr. High is a refined school from the north, known for their top strikers.
episodes.title: The Double Prince of the Snowfield

episodes.synopsis: Here to shake things up, Bunny Cottontail has entered the field. An unpredictable force, Bunny is a beginner at the game but an incredibly fast learner and runner.
episodes.title: Explosion! Operation Snow Princess

episodes.synopsis: Raimon's next opponent is the brilliant Alia Academy, but Alia faces their own darkness.
episodes.title: The Sun Garden's Dream

episodes.synopsis: With Hunter on the bench, Alia Academy is in trouble.
episodes.title: The Ultimate Personal Technique

episodes.synopsis: Xavier blasts through as a one-man show, but soccer is a team sport. To have a chance at winning this game Hunter will have to convince Xavier to trust his teammates.
episodes.title: The Ultimate Technique, Its Name Is...

episodes.synopsis: The Raimon Eleven are on cloud nine from reaching the semi-finals, that is until they hear they'll be facing the legendary goalie and captain, Mark Evans.
episodes.title: Scattered Eleven

episodes.synopsis: Under the legendary Mark Evans, Everytown Junior High has become a formidable opponent. Maxime must rise to the occasion and bring the Raimon Eleven together.
episodes.title: The Legendary Captain

episodes.synopsis: Now that Maxime has stepped up and rallied the team, the Raimon Eleven are back in business.
episodes.title: Surpassing the Legend!

episodes.synopsis: The final showdown between Raimon and Lunar Prime is almost here, but illness and injury plague both teams.
episodes.title: Nosaka's Declaration of War

episodes.synopsis: It's the final battle: Raimon vs. Lunar Prime. Will Heath and Elliot be able to overcome their animosity and play honestly? This heated match is just getting started.
episodes.title: Clashing Soccer!!

episodes.synopsis: The second half is under way and it's the fiercest fight yet. With Sonny, Elliot, and Heath all aiming for victory, who will come out on top?
episodes.title: Dash to the Top
